evidence_snippets: Note: Whenever your app displays information about places sourced from the Places SDK for Android, the app must also show all relevant attributions that are returned by the API.

Policies and Terms All applications that use the Places SDK for Android must adhere to the requirements described in the Google Maps Platform Terms of Service , Usage and Billing , and Displaying Attributions .
This means you can build rich apps based on places that mean something to the user, to complement the straightforward geographic-based services offered by the Android location services .
